import thinkthen as tt

# each ticket goes to the team its words name:
# billing, shipping, and account
teams = ["billing", "shipping", "account"]
for text in ["I was billed twice for one order.",
        "My parcel is a week late.",
        "I am locked out of my account."]:
    print(tt.choose("Which team owns this?", text,
        options=teams))
